file_protocol:
FILE FORMAT
Existing file write:
```language relative/path.ext
<<<<<<< SEARCH
exact current text
=======
replacement text
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```
New file write:
```language relative/path.ext
complete contents
```
Command to execute:
```bash
real command
```
A FILE WRITE fence always has a language AND relative path on its opening line. A pathless bash fence is a COMMAND. `bash relative/path.sh` is a shell FILE WRITE. Never emit an unnamed code fence. SEARCH must exactly match CURRENT FILES. Never use TODOs, placeholders, stubs, '# rest unchanged', or invented existing-file contents.
